name: BirdSift
description:
BirdSift helps web designers, agencies, and local SEO freelancers find local businesses on Google Places and turn verified findings into saved leads and cold-outreach drafts — without leaving Claude.

Sign in once with OAuth (no API key). Your BirdSift workspace stays in sync with app.birdsift.com: saved leads, credits, and search history are the same whether you use the app or this connector.

Tools:
• get_credit_balance — check credits before spending (free)
• list_leads / get_lead — browse saved leads with website-quality flags: no website, not mobile-friendly, outdated design (free)
• export_leads_csv — download up to 500 saved leads as CSV text (free)
• search_businesses — search one location + category on Google Places and save results as leads (up to 1 credit per newly found business)
• draft_outreach_email — draft one personalized cold email grounded only in verified facts BirdSift already checked; 1 credit only when a draft is produced (BirdSift never sends email)

Claude turns natural-language requests into structured search arguments — there is no separate planning endpoint. Credit-spending tools require confirmation before each call.

New accounts get 25 free credits; additional credits are purchased at app.birdsift.com. draft_outreach_email returns drafted: false (not an error) when no verified hook exists for a lead.

_published_faq.name: How do I add BirdSift to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add BirdSift to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.birdsift.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the BirdSift MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: BirdSift provides these MCP tools: draft_outreach_email, export_leads_csv, get_credit_balance, get_lead, list_leads, and search_businesses.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to BirdSift?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to BirdSift in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
BirdSift requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
BirdSift is developed by BirdSift. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
